run_epoch: run one optimization epoch over a TensorFlow session with given cost operation and reset
print_stats: print experiment statistics including log mean final error and mean epoch time
get_net_path: get the network checkpoint path by joining a directory with a name and .l2l extension
get_default_net_config: get a default neural network configuration dictionary with CoordinateWiseDeepLSTM settings
get_config: get problem configuration including problem instance, network config, and variable assignments for supported problems
